Seven days, twenty minutes a day

Start Day 1
1

Me

I can introduce myself. Say five true sentences about yourself, without reading.

  • Lesson 1 and Sound Lab (sp- and st-)
  • Shadow "My script"
  • Word Order and Speech Mode: Meet someone new
  • Voice note: Tell me about yourself. 30 seconds, no reading.
2

Order and ask

I can order food and drink. Order a drink and something to eat, and pay.

  • Lesson 2 and Sound Lab (the English h)
  • Shadow "Ordering coffee"
  • Fill the Gap and Speech Mode: Café order
  • Voice note: Order your real breakfast in English. 30 seconds.
3

Questions

I can ask for what I need. Ask where, what time and how, and ask for something politely.

  • Lesson 3 and Sound Lab (short i and long ee)
  • Shadow "At the airport"
  • Flash Translate and Speech Mode: Airport check-in
  • Voice note: Ask me three questions. I will answer them.
4

Yesterday

I can say what I did. Say three things you did yesterday and how it was.

  • Lesson 4 and Sound Lab (-ed endings)
  • Shadow "Yesterday"
  • Word Order and Speech Mode: Chat about yesterday
  • Voice note: What did you do yesterday? 45 seconds.
5

Opinions

I can give my opinion. Say what you think, give a reason, and agree or disagree.

  • Lesson 5 and Sound Lab (th)
  • Shadow "My opinion"
  • Fill the Gap and Speech Mode: Coffee chat: opinions
  • Voice note: The city or the beach? Say why. 45 seconds.
6

Keep talking

I can keep a conversation going. Ask for a repeat, ask what a word means, and send the question back.

  • Lesson 6 and Sound Lab (v and b)
  • Shadow "Keep talking"
  • Flash Translate and Speech Mode: Meet someone new, without Help me
  • Voice note: The first minute of your talk: who you are and what you like.
7

The 2-minute talk

I can talk for two minutes. Give a two-minute talk in four parts, with no script.

  • Lesson 7 and Sound Lab
  • Shadow your own talk
  • Rehearse against the 2-minute clock
  • Day 7 call: give the talk to your tutor

Questions people ask

What is Week2Speak?

Week2Speak is an English speaking programme for Spanish speakers. It combines a 7-day Sprint with a tutor who speaks Spanish, short daily lessons, and practice rooms for speaking out loud: Speech Mode, sentence games and shadowing.

Can you really speak English in 7 days?

You will not be fluent in 7 days. The Sprint aims for something smaller and real: by Day 7 you can introduce yourself, order, ask questions and give a 2-minute talk in English without a script. Your Day 1 and Day 7 recordings show the change.

Who is Week2Speak for?

Adults whose first language is Spanish who understand some English but freeze when they have to speak. If you have never studied English at all, the first week will feel fast.

How much does it cost?

The founding cohort is free and has ten places. Prices for the paid plans are set before the public launch.

Do I need to download an app?

No. Everything runs in the browser on your phone or computer. The microphone works in Chrome, Edge and Safari; in other browsers you can type your answers instead.

Which English accents can I learn?

American, British and Australian. The voices come from your own device, so the accents you hear depend on the voices your phone or computer has installed.
